What they did
The user plugged a Kasa smart plug into their Christmas tree. They then gave Claude Code a short instruction to find the plug, add it, and set up some timers. The post doesn't describe the mechanics: how the plug was discovered, what tools or access Claude used, or whether the user had to step in.

The user says the tree is now automated. The post gives no details on the timer schedule, how many attempts it took, or any problems.

with

Copy prompt
Find the new [brand, e.g. Kasa] smart plug on my home network, add it to my setup, and name it [device name, e.g. Christmas tree]. Then set timers so it turns on at [on time] and off at [off time] on [days]. When it's done, show me the schedule you created and confirm the plug responds to an on/off test. Before changing any existing devices or settings, pause and tell me what you're about to do.
